WorkspacePasswordInvalid: Use 12 or more characters, up to 1024 bytes.

WorkspaceStorageFailed: Could not safely read or save the library. Your draft is retained.

WorkspaceDraftInvalid: Use a unique name and valid subscription source or node content.

MigrationConsent: Apply this import and skip unsupported options. The current draft will be replaced.
MigrationReady: Source selected. Review it, then choose Import to download.
ArchiveHelp: Classic age X25519 only. The key stays in this session and is cleared after each attempt. Passphrase, SSH, plugin and post-quantum keys are not supported.
ArchiveExportHelp: Encrypt a Hub backup for this recipient. Keep the matching private key separately; it is required to restore the backup.
ArchiveKeyInvalid: Enter a valid classic age X25519 key.
ArchiveUnsupported: This age key or archive type is not supported. Use classic X25519.
ArchiveInvalid: Could not unlock or encrypt this backup. Check the key and file integrity.
OperationScriptHelp: Edit individual nodes or work with the whole list using Rhai, not Rust or JavaScript. Scripts run locally and cannot access files, the network, commands, or credentials.
OperationScriptSourceContext: context.source_kind is local, gist, https, collection, or unknown. context.source_label is the item's display name when available, not its URL. context.member_index starts at 1 and is available for collection members.
OperationScriptUnderlyingProxy: Set node.underlying_proxy to the name of an existing node to use as its upstream proxy. Set it to an empty string to clear it. Use node.udp_over_tcp on supported sing-box nodes.
OperationScriptArgumentsHelp: Read these text values by name in context.arguments. They are included in saved and exported operation plans. Do not enter tokens, passwords, or other secrets.
OperationScriptArgumentNameInvalid: Start with an English letter or underscore. Use up to 32 English letters, digits, or underscores.
OperationScriptArgumentValueInvalid: Use a single line with no control characters and up to 256 UTF-8 bytes.
OperationScriptArgumentDuplicate: This argument already exists. Edit its value or choose another name.
OperationScriptArgumentLimit: Each script can have up to 16 arguments. Remove one before adding another.
OperationScriptSignatures: Use transform to edit one node, or operator(nodes, context) to return existing nodes in a new order or omit some. Use filter(nodes, context) to return one true/false value per input, preserving the original nodes and order.
OperationScriptContext: context.source_format describes the input. Choose the Gist format in Output before previewing. context.target_format uses that format, or sing-box when preparing collection members.
OperationScriptFields: Edit name, server, port, included, udp, tfo, sni, verify_tls, and alpn where supported. Set node.alpn to an array of strings. Review server changes before using the output: clients may send existing credentials to the new server.
OperationScriptReadOnlyFields: node.protocol, node.tls, and node.transport are read-only. If TLS or transport is not declared, its field returns ().
OperationScriptRegex: Use regex_match(text, pattern) to test for a match, or regex_replace(text, pattern, replacement) to replace matches. Use $1 in the replacement to insert the first capture.
OperationScriptBatchExampleHelp: The batch example swaps the first 2 nodes without removing any. Inserting or copying it does not run it.
RenameTrimEach: Trim leading and trailing whitespace after each rule
SliceHelp: Dependency-linked nodes are retained, so the final count may exceed the selected range.
DeduplicateNameHelp: Different servers with the same name may be removed. Dependency-linked nodes take priority and are retained.
NetworkHelp: Matches IP addresses only; does not resolve DNS.
ResolutionAdHelp: AD is asserted by the provider, not verified locally. Unsigned domains may fail.
ResolutionDnssec: The DNS provider did not assert required authentication.
ResolutionOptionsInvalid: Check DNS options and regular expressions.
ResolutionStatAuthenticated: Replies with provider-asserted AD (not locally verified)
OperationPlanHelp: Plans do not automatically include source subscriptions, credential or token fields, per-node selections or consent. Operation text may itself contain private patterns, hosts, SNI, labels or secrets; use plaintext consent and a private file. Import replaces the chain and requires a fresh preview.
OperationPlanLoaded: Operation plan imported. Preview again before saving or uploading.
RegionNamesHelp: Unknown regions retain their original name.
ShuffleHelp: The same seed and input order produce the same order. This is not security randomness.
OperationInvalid: Check the enabled operations and their fields before previewing.
OperationRestored: Saved steps are loaded. Review them, then preview the changes.
OperationChainHelp: Applied in order. Domain resolution requires separate session authorization; adding an operation does not start it.
PropertyUdpOverTcpHelp: Applies only to native sing-box SOCKS and Shadowsocks nodes.
PropertyVerifyTlsHelp: Require certificate verification; this cannot disable verification.
PropertySkippedHelp: Unsupported nodes are retained and reported as skipped.
ResolutionConsent: Authorize sending selected node endpoint domain names to the selected DNS providers over HTTPS with strict TLS verification for this session only. This consent is not saved.
ResolutionPreview: Resolves node server addresses only; system DNS is unchanged. After separate authorization, endpoint domains are sent to the selected provider over HTTPS with strict TLS verification. Unresolved nodes are retained.
ResolutionConsentRequired: Authorize domain resolution for this session first.
ResolutionRateLimited: The DNS service rate-limited the request.
ResolutionBudget: Domain resolution exceeded its request budget.
OperationRegexSortUnmatched: Order of nodes that match no pattern
OperationProtocolsHelp: Use parsed protocol names, for example ss, vmess, vless, trojan.
OperationTemplateHelp: Placeholders: {name}, {protocol}, {region}, {server}, {port}, {source_index}, {index}, and {index:02} through {index:06}. Index is the current 1-based position after prior sorting; server and port reflect prior edits.

RelayDropFile: Choose a file or drop one here.
FilePickerBusy: Earlier folder reads are still finishing. You can cancel; reconnect an unavailable drive before retrying. Cancelling does not interrupt an operating-system file read.
FilePickerError: Cannot read this folder. Check its location and access permissions, or choose another folder.
FilePickerTruncated: This folder is large; only the first 4,096 entries were read. Enter a more specific folder path if the item is missing.
FilePickerInvalid: Choose a regular file, or enter one new filename without separators or control characters.
FilePickerPrivacy: Local browsing only. File contents are read only after import is confirmed; nothing is uploaded here. System folder permissions still apply.
RelayEngineSelected: Connection checker selected. It will run only when you start a check.
RelayEnginePurpose: sing-box checks proxy authentication and real HTTPS connectivity. Import, backup and upload do not need it; a TCP-open port alone cannot prove a node works.
RelayEditInvalid: Invalid node edits or filter. Check the regular expressions, names, and 512-byte limits.
RelayEditorHelp: Filter original names with Rust regular expressions; replace is literal. Names remain hidden until revealed.
RelayExcluded: Filtered or manually excluded, including dependents
RelayStrictProbeHelp: By default, sources requesting certificate bypass are checked with strict TLS; the imported configuration is not changed. Compatibility mode is an unsafe opt-in for this run only.
RelayNoHealthyHelp: No healthy nodes were verified. Check the local network and checker, then retry; unknown results are retained and are not all failures.
RelayLatencyHelp: Cold HTTPS first-response latency, by public target (not a bandwidth test):
RelayReasonTunnelRejected: Proxy could not establish the tunnel; cause unconfirmed, retained
RelayRateLimited: GitHub rate limit reached. No automatic retry. Wait at least:
RelayRateLimitedUnknown: GitHub rate limit reached. Wait at least a minute before retrying; the result is not a dead-node verdict.
RelayRetrySession: The server requested a wait that cannot be scheduled. Online subscription actions are paused for this session; offline preview is still available.
RelayIntro: Import, edit and sync subscriptions. No Surge module or local server required.
RelayTestNodes: Check connectivity and remove confirmed failures
RelaySourceHelp: Use a Gist ID or public HTTPS text subscription. Import does not connect to proxy nodes; external sites never receive the GitHub token.
RelaySelectFile: This Gist has several files. Select the node file, then check again.
RelayImportFile: Import node file or relay backup…
RelayCleanHelp: Automatic removal by the health check requires repeated connection failures across two targets and two rounds, with stable baselines before and after. Unknown, unsupported, security-blocked and inconclusive strict-TLS results are retained.
RelayTokenHelp: Use a GitHub token with Gist access. It is used only for this session and is never included in backups.
RelayReuseOutput: The retained output Gist will be updated; a duplicate will not be created.
RelayBackupWarning: Copies and exported files contain plaintext node credentials. Backups include nodes and safe relay settings, never a GitHub token. Store privately; existing files are not replaced.
RelayBackupInvalid: This is not a valid relay backup or supported node file. Existing session data was preserved.
RelayFileError: Cannot open or save this file. Choose a new file outside the repository and app; existing files are not replaced.
RelayFileSaved: File saved with private access permissions.
RelayFileExists: That file already exists and was preserved. Save again with a new filename.
RelayImported: File imported. Check the nodes before uploading; old health results and upload permissions were not restored.
RelayDialogHelp: Processing the selected file locally. Its contents stay hidden.
RelayOneFile: Drop one node file or relay backup at a time.
RelayFormatOnly: Formatting only: no node connections or health claims. Untested nodes are retained.
RelayCreateHelp: Leave the output Gist empty to create a new secret Gist with your token. Anyone with its link can read it; it is not encrypted.
RelayCreated: Output Gist created and verified; its target is retained for this session.
RelayFormats: Automatically recognizes Surge node text, URI/Base64 subscriptions, sing-box JSON and Sub-Store/Shadowrocket/mihomo node JSON or YAML. Import exported nodes, not a full app configuration or Sub-Store settings backup.

RelaySourceFile: Source filename (optional; detected from the link or single-file Gist)

RelayCompatibility: For this run, allow certificate bypass only where the source explicitly requires it (unsafe).
RelayDoh: Use Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 DoH for probes (sends endpoint names; output hostnames are unchanged).
RelayPublishConsent: I authorize this upload to create a secret Gist or replace only the selected output file. Secret Gists are unlisted, not encrypted.
RelayPublicConsent: Allow publishing private node credentials to a PUBLIC Gist (high risk).
RelayPublishWarning: Upload is an explicit network write. Cancellation cannot undo a write already accepted by GitHub. Keep input and output Gists different.
RelayWorking: Private relay running; no task-history record.
RelayWait: Wait for the current operation to finish before starting a relay.
RelayUpload: Uploading selected output and verifying readback

RelayOutputInvalid: Use a valid output filename and a Gist different from the source, or leave the output Gist empty to create one.
RelayNameInvalid: Output name and filename must each be at most 64 Unicode characters, without control characters.
RelayOptionsInvalid: Use 1–8 parallel checks and a timeout of 1–20 seconds.
RelayTokenInvalid: Enter a valid session token. Upload requires a token; public previews may be anonymous.
RelayConsentRequired: Authorize output creation or replacement before uploading.
RelayConfigInvalid: Check the source, distinct output, name lengths, engine and verification settings.
RelayCancelling: Cancelling. Waiting for the worker and any owned engine; accepted Gist creation receipts are retained.
RelayCancelled: Cancelled. A write already accepted by GitHub may still have completed; inspect any retained output target.
RelayPublished: Output upload read back and verified.
RelayUnchanged: Output is meaningfully unchanged; no upload was needed.
RelayPreviewReady: Preview complete. Nothing was uploaded; plaintext remains hidden.
RelayWorkerStopped: The private relay stopped unexpectedly. No success is claimed; check the output before retrying a possible upload.
RelayNoHealthy: No node has verified success. Existing output was not changed.
RelaySourceChanged: The source changed during checking. Run again before publishing.
RelaySubscriptionInvalid: The selected file is not a valid supported node-only subscription.
RelayDependencyInvalid: Node dependencies are unresolved, ambiguous or cyclic.
RelayRenderFailed: The output could not be prepared safely. Existing output was not changed.
RelayConnectionFailed: GitHub request failed. Check the connection and try again.
RelayHttpStatus: GitHub rejected the request; HTTP status:
RelayResponseInvalid: GitHub returned an invalid or incomplete response.
RelayTooLarge: Gist content exceeds the bounded relay size limit.
RelayFileListIncomplete: The file list is incomplete; the selected file cannot be confirmed absent.
RelayOutputChanged: The output changed during checking. Preview it again before publishing.
RelayPublicOutput: Publishing to a public Gist requires separate confirmation.
RelayWriteUncertain: Creation or update may have been accepted. Inspect your Gists before retrying to avoid duplicates.
RelayReadbackFailed: The output readback did not match. Inspect the output before retrying.
RelayPinnedTarget: Revision-pinned raw URLs are not accepted. Use a Gist ID or a latest-file URL without a revision.
RelayEngineUnavailable: The connection checker is unavailable. Use Detect again or Choose installed app. Import, save, backup and upload do not need it.
RelayEngineFailed: The local check engine failed. Engine failure is not dead-node evidence.
RelayUnsupported: The source format or operation cannot be faithfully supported. Existing output was not changed.
VaultIntro: Password-protected configurations. Nothing is fetched automatically.
VaultPrepareHelp: A verified encrypted copy of the originals stays local. A sanitized encrypted template library is prepared for publication. Original files remain untouched.
VaultPrepareSourcesHelp: One local path per line, or drop files here. Existing destinations are never replaced.
VaultManagedStorage: Fixed project storage; valid library locations are remembered automatically.
VaultStorageUnavailable: Project storage is unavailable. The bundled library can still be unlocked; saving requires an available project.
VaultImportEncryptedHint: Drop an encrypted library to import it into fixed local storage after unlocking. The source file is kept.
VaultPasswordHelp: Use a long, unique passphrase. There is no password reset or recovery key.
VaultLockedHelp: Names and configurations stay hidden until unlocked. Public ciphertext can still be attacked offline, so a strong password matters.
VaultSessionHelp: Locks on focus loss or after five idle minutes. Locking discards unsaved changes. Secrets are not saved in preferences or task history; complete memory erasure is not guaranteed.
VaultAutoLocked: Library locked for privacy. Enter the password to continue.
VaultWorking: Processing securely. Locking will discard any late result.
VaultPrepared: Encrypted backup and publication library verified. Original files remain unchanged.
VaultImportHint: Local configuration path, or drop files on this page
VaultImportHelp: Imported contents are stored only in the encrypted library when you save. Original files are not deleted.
VaultImported: Configuration imported. Save the encrypted library to keep it.
VaultEmpty: No configurations yet. Import a local file above.
VaultShadowrocketHelp: Shadowrocket subscriptions are added separately. The configuration export does not embed this URL.
VaultNoFetch: URLs stay in this session and are never requested here.
VaultEditHelp: Editing shows plaintext here. Apply and save before leaving the app; automatic locking discards unsaved changes. The public sample is not changed.
VaultUnsavedChanges: Apply and save the changes, or lock the template library to discard them before closing.
VaultAutoLockedUnsaved: Automatically locked; unsaved template changes were discarded. Apply and save before leaving the app.
VaultPublicGateHelp: Bundled templates use a public password as a manual gate, not confidentiality. Do not reuse it for private configurations.
VaultTemplatePreviewHelp: Template preview only. Subscription fields are applied when you copy or export.
VaultPlaintextConsent: I understand that copying or exporting reveals plaintext.
VaultClipboardWarning: Clipboard history, sync, screenshots and other apps can retain plaintext. Export outside any Git project; do not publish plaintext files.
VaultExportHint: Absolute path outside the project, for example Downloads/profile.conf
VaultOverwrite: Allow replacing an existing destination file
VaultExported: Plaintext configuration exported. Protect the file and do not commit it.
VaultRemoveConfirm: Remove this entry from the library? The original file is not affected. Save to persist this change.

InvalidRuleSetPolicy: No edge spaces, line breaks, commas, quotes or comment markers; internal spaces are allowed.

SelectItem: Select an item to view its details.
ProgressUnknown: Stage duration varies; see live activity below.

ConfirmNetwork: This action requires network access. Continue?

AboutDescription: A desktop interface for browsing project resources and running explicit workspace tasks.
HelpIntro: Choose a topic below. Templates and subscription relay do not require a workspace.
HelpRelay:
1. Import a Gist/raw link or local file. Raw links are read directly; import never tests nodes.
2. Review the detected format and counts. Optional real connectivity checks use automatically detected sing-box; choose the installed program if missing, never type a path.
3. Save or upload the prepared result. Upload needs a GitHub token, not sing-box; it revalidates the source without repeating checks. Backups contain plaintext node credentials but no token. Secret Gists are not encrypted.
HelpWorkspace: The workspace is the project directory used by local tasks. Check the selected path before running a task.
WorkspaceNotApplied: Load the project folder before running tasks. An unvalidated path will not be saved; appearance settings can still be saved.
ReopenWorkspace: Reopen the saved workspace at startup
OpenWorkspaceHint: Open a workspace to browse resources. Startup does not request folder access automatically.
WorkspacePermissionHelp: The app does not scan folders on startup by default. Opening Desktop, Documents, Downloads or external volumes may require macOS consent. For unattended tasks, use an explicitly selected local workspace outside protected folders. New ad-hoc development builds may require consent again.
HelpUpdates: Updates may write generated files. Review the task and workspace before confirming.
HelpSources: Adding or removing a source saves its configuration locally. Run a full update to rebuild the affected bundle; quick update skips functional bundles. Browsing remains offline.
HelpGit: Repository actions are user-initiated. Review changed files and the selected branch before any write or remote operation.
HelpShortcuts: Search to narrow module and rule lists; select an item for details. Select filtered results adds the current results without clearing earlier selections; clear selection resets them all. Ctrl / Command + 1–5 opens Overview, Library, Tasks, Repository, and Subscription relay. Drag a project folder onto the window to load it.
HelpPrivacy: Workspace files stay local unless you explicitly run an action that uses the network.
SourceTrust: Only add sources you trust; refreshing a source can contact its server.
ConfirmPull: Pull changes from the remote repository?
ConfirmPush: Push commits to the remote repository?
GitSafety: Review the branch, selected files, and remote before continuing.
OverviewDescription: Browse project resources and see the current workspace at a glance.
ShareLogsWarning: Review logs before sharing; they may contain private paths or sensitive data.
TaskIntro: Choose what to maintain. Nothing runs until you start it.
ValidateDescription: Check local rules, modules, references and safety boundaries without changing them.
CatalogDescription: Browse the live local module and rule catalogs; nothing is generated or written.
UpdateDescription: Fetch upstream modules and rules, compile, check and publish the complete local output.
QuickDescription: Update rules without rebuilding functional module bundles.
GamingDescription: Rebuild gaming categories from existing local inputs; this does not fetch upstream changes.
AdBlockDescription: Fetch ad-block sources and rebuild PROMAX, typed rules, mirrors and the catalog.
SrsDescription: Compile current local rules using your sing-box executable. No upstream download.
SingboxRequired: Set a sing-box executable in Settings before running this task.
HistoryIntro: Local task records survive restarts. Unfinished records do not prove that a worker has stopped.
RecordHistoryHelp: Keep up to 100 local task summaries, without workspace paths or diagnostic logs by default.
DeveloperModeHelp: Show diagnostic options. Safety validation and write confirmations stay enabled.
DiagnosticLogsHelp: Opt-in only. Excerpts are bounded and common credentials are redacted, but review before sharing: logs may contain private data.
ConfirmClearHistory: Delete saved finished task records and their log excerpts? This cannot be undone; unfinished records are kept.
ConfirmRemoveUnfinishedHistory: Remove all unfinished task-history records? This cannot be undone. Use this only after checking that no other Script Hub window is running a task; records for active tasks in other instances will also be removed.
NoSavedLogs: No diagnostic logs were retained for this task.
DependencyLicenseHelp: Verbatim notices are bundled for offline use, including font and SQLite notices. Copy the full text to inspect it in your preferred reader.
LicenseScope: Project-authored code follows the repository's GPLv3 license. Third-party rules, scripts and libraries retain their own licenses; this is not a claim that every source is cleared for redistribution.
SourceValidationHint: Public GitHub Raw or jsDelivr module URL only; HTTPS, no credentials, query or fragment.
RelayReasonAddressUnverified: Address cannot be verified without changing transport or DNS behavior
InputPasteHelp: Paste proxy links, Surge nodes, Mihomo YAML, sing-box JSON or Sub-Store node data. Data is parsed; scripts are never executed.
RelayInputUnavailable: The subscription request failed. No output was changed.
RelayInputLimited: The source requested a cooldown. Retry after
NativePresetHelp: Append editable Rust operations inspired by Entrance v9.4, not a full JavaScript port. DNS and protocol filtering start disabled. Unsupported parameter changes are reported as skipped.
ScheduleHelp: Sync updates an existing output Gist only. Create or select that Gist and approve publication first. After a successful run, the interval starts again. Unchanged output is not uploaded.
ScheduleStopBeforeImport: Stop scheduled sync before importing a file.
ScheduleSessionOnly: Runs while this application is open. Credentials stay in this session; quit or Clear stops the plan. Stop before editing. Cancellation cannot undo a write already accepted by GitHub.
ScheduleNeedsPreview: Preview the current plan before enabling synchronization.
ScheduleNeedsOutput: Create or select an output Gist and confirm publication first.
ScheduleIndexedEdits: Remote updates can change node order. Replace individual node edits with reusable operations before enabling sync.
WorkspaceListEmptySubscriptions: No subscriptions yet. Create or import one to begin.
WorkspaceListEmptyCollections: No collections yet. Create one to group subscriptions.
